title: Lady
studio_context: Side one of the Shakara LP (EMI Nigeria, 1972).

drum_performances.name: Tony Allen
drum_performances.why_it_matters: A slow, soft Africa 70 groove: his double-kick pattern played quietly under Fela's satire.

drums.description: Double kicks played softly, 1 and its "e", 3 and its "e", under a half-open hat.
